assumptions.total_exposure: assumption of the case: Banco Andino holds 6.0 trillion CLP of loans (about 1.3 per cent of the system)
assumptions.commercial_split: assumption of the case, UNVERIFIED on a CMF primary source: 60 per cent of the commercial book is assessed individually, 40 per cent in groups
assumptions.arrears_ratio: assumption of the case: exposure 1 to 89 days past due is 1.2 times the 90-day ratio
assumptions.flow_factor: assumption of the case: the annual default rate is half the 90-day stock ratio
assumptions.tiers: assumption of the case: one high-risk tier per portfolio (LTV above 80 per cent, arrears in the system, no guarantee, categories A5 to B4), its share solved so that the B-1 provision index equals the CMF index
assumptions.eir: assumption of the case, order of magnitude only: mortgages 8%, consumer instalment 20%, cards 30%, commercial group 12%, individual 8%
assumptions.asset_correlation: assumption of the case in the ranges of Basel CRE31: mortgages 0.15, consumer instalment 0.10, cards 0.04, commercial group 0.12, individual 0.20
assumptions.recoveries: assumption of the case: recovered share = 80 per cent of the collateral appraisal plus a case-specific extra; cash flows at 12 and 24 months, discounted at the EIR
assumptions.weighting: dossier 02 B.4: factors +1, 0 and -2 with weights 25, 50 and 25 per cent

rationale.en: House price outlook on high-LTV mortgages, not in the model (expert, assumption of the case: 10 per cent of the base Stage 2 ECL of the segment)
rationale.es: Perspectiva de precios de viviendas en hipotecarios de PVG alto, fuera del modelo (experto, supuesto del caso: 10 % de la ECL de Etapa 2 del segmento en el base)

rationale.en: Card utilisation drift not in the model (expert, assumption of the case: 8 per cent of the base Stage 1 ECL of the segment)
rationale.es: Deriva de uso de tarjetas fuera del modelo (experto, supuesto del caso: 8 % de la ECL de Etapa 1 del segmento en el base)

details.weighting_basis: dossier 02 B.4 (worked example of the non-linearity of the weighted ECL)

title.es: Soluciones alternativas del Anejo 9 de la Circular 4/2017 del BdE

details.limitation: Circular 4/2017 point numbers as of Circular 6/2021; whether they shifted after Circular 1/2025 is UNVERIFIED; the collateral haircut table is not transcribed, so the case applies a stated haircut

bank.name: Banco Andino

notice.en: Synthetic: Banco Andino is a generated bank, calibrated to public CMF system aggregates (parameters and hash in the generator model record); its rows are not observations of any bank. UF-indexed mortgages are converted to CLP at the SII value of 2026-08-31: 40,873.77 CLP per UF.
notice.es: Sintético: Banco Andino es un banco generado, calibrado a agregados públicos del sistema de la CMF (parámetros y hash en el registro del modelo generador); sus filas no son observaciones de ningún banco. Las hipotecas indexadas a UF se convierten a CLP al valor del SII del 2026-08-31: 40.873,77 CLP por UF.
